verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a first-party filing-fees page and a Fee Calculator that it says determines "the exact filing fee required," so fees come from its own tools rather than a contact form. The pack never shows an actual dollar amount for any form. Missing for 10: verbatim published fee amounts per form/transaction in the evidence, confirmation that amounts are statutory/current, independent or hands-on corroboration that the calculator returns concrete figures.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form

citations.quote: you can use our Fee Calculator to determine the exact filing fee required.
